ryans.name: Ryan McKenzie
ryans.title: Canadian entrepreneur and marketer; co-founder of Tru Earth, the direct-to-consumer laundry-strip brand
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan McKenzie** is a Canadian entrepreneur and marketer. In 2019 he co-founded Tru Earth, a Vancouver-area company that sells concentrated laundry detergent strips and other household cleaning products in compact packaging, with Brad Liski and Kevin Hinton [1][2][3][4]. He served as the company's chief marketing officer until 2024 and, according to his public LinkedIn profile, remains a director [11][12][14].
known_for: Direct-to-consumer marketing for eco laundry detergent strips
